title: Brighten & Blur Set - Color Corrector + Loose Setting Powder Face Set

specifications.ingredientPreferences: sulfateFree, crueltyFree, antioxidants, siliconeFree, cleanAtSephora, parabenFree, hyaluronicAcid, fragranceFree, peptides, squalane

descriptionHtml:
✓ Good for: Pores✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Non-Comedogenic✓ Good for: Dark Circles✓ Long-wearing✓ Full Coverage

What it is: A set featuring a color corrector and loose setting powder that erase the appearance of dark circles and set looks with an airbrushed finish.


Coverage: Full


Highlighted Ingredients:

- Hyaluronic Acid, Caffeine, and Dipeptide-2: Visibly reduce puffiness.

- Bamboo Stem Extract: Absorbs excess sebum so skin feels soft and fresh.


Ingredient Callouts: These products are vegan and cruelty-free.


How to Use+

Suggested Usage:

-Dot Revealer Extra Bright over dark circles and any discoloration you want to neutralize or color balance.

-Blend out before layering your favorite concealer for a seamless look. 

-Bake and set with Cloud Set Loose Powder for an airbrushed finish and to lock makeup in place.


Ingredients+
-Hyaluronic Acid, Caffeine, and Dipeptide-2: Visibly reduces puffiness.
-Bamboo Stem Extract: Absorbs excess sebum so skin feels soft and fresh.

Revealer Extra Bright Serum-Powered Color Corrector
Water/Aqua/Eau, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Octyldodecanol, Polyglyceryl-2 Dipolyhydroxystearate, Ethylhexyl Olivate, Glycerin, Undecane, Polyhydroxystearic Acid, Mica, Polyglyceryl-3 Diisostearate, Silica, Galactoarabinan, Propanediol, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Wax, Tridecane, Lecithin, Caffeine, Panthenol, Acetyl Tetrapeptide-5, Dipeptide-2, Sodium Hyaluronate, Squalane, Glyceryl Oleate, Pentylene Glycol, Tocopherol, Sodium Gluconate, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Ascorbyl Palmitate, Hydrogenated Palm Glycerides Citrate, Phenethyl Alcohol [+/-: CI 77891 (Titanium Dioxide), CI 77491, CI 77492, CI 77499 (Iron Oxides), CI 77742 (Manganese Violet)].

Cloud Set Translucent Loose Setting + Blurring Powder
Mica, Silica, Isodecyl Neopentanoate, Bambusa Arundinacea Stem Extract, Boron Nitride, Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil, C15-19 Alkane, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Tocopherol, Citric Acid, Glyceryl Undecylenate, Glyceryl Caprylate, Pentylene Glycol, Sodium Dehydroacetate [+/-: Yellow 5 Lake (CI 19140), Red 28 Lake (CI 45410), Red 6 (CI 15850)].
